attempts.text:
The prognosis is influenced by several documented factors. The surgical findings included a Gleason 3+4 (ISUP grade group 2) and positive surgical margins, which are concerning features. Counterbalancing these are the absence of extraprostatic extension, non-invasion of the seminal vesicles, absence of lymphovascular invasion, and no lymph node metastasis. The biopsy showed a lower grade (Gleason 3+3, ISUP grade group 1) compared to the prostatectomy specimen.

The nodal status is documented as negative (no lymph node metastasis). The preoperative PSA was 12. Information that would significantly revise this prognosis includes the postoperative PSA and its subsequent trajectory. Missing postoperative PSA or follow-up data widens the uncertainty regarding future disease behavior. The current horizon suggests a follow-up period of approximately 59.4 months without an event, though the heuristic sensitivity range for recurrence extends between 47.5 and 71.3 months.

The patient underwent a robot-assisted radical prostatectomy with a pathological stage pT2. Key findings include positive surgical margins, absence of seminal vesicle invasion, and no lymph node metastasis. The preoperative PSA was 12. The biopsy demonstrated a Gleason 3+3 (ISUP grade group 1), which differs from the prostatectomy specimen's Gleason 3+4 (ISUP grade group 2). The absence of lymph node metastasis was documented.

Factors influencing prognosis include the positive surgical margins and the higher Gleason grade observed post-surgery compared to the biopsy. Conversely, favorable findings include no extraprostatic extension, no seminal vesicle invasion, and no lymphovascular invasion. Nodal status was documented as no lymph node metastasis.

The prognosis is informed by the surgical findings, but the postoperative PSA and its subsequent trajectory remain unknown, which widens the uncertainty. Information regarding postoperative PSA and its trajectory would be crucial to revise this assessment. The heuristic sensitivity range for recurrence is between 47.5 and 71.3 months.
